rules.statement: When questions as to title arise in a partition suit, whether it be between the original parties to it or an intervenient who seeks to come in after the interlocutory decree and another party, the Court should not refer the parties concerned to a separate action to have such questions in the first instance decided, but the same should be adjudicated upon in the partition suit itself.
